answer: An agent marketplace can weight governance votes by tokens locked for 90 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight: each fake voice is an echo of the same capital. To command a majority, an attacker must lock more tokens than all honest voters combined, tying up funds and bearing price risk. A tide of new accounts cannot deepen the lagoon of stake behind them.
